# Context Engine

> Context Engine is an open-source toolkit for AI-enhanced deliberation and large-group sensemaking, with public and private surveys, AI-assisted analysis, permanent records, and cryptographic access control.

Canonical site: https://contextengine.sh/
Static summary: https://contextengine.sh/discoverability.html
Canonical GitHub repository: https://github.com/AgalmicSoftware/context-engine
Latest GitHub source tree: https://github.com/AgalmicSoftware/context-engine/tree/main

## Latest branch documents

- README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgalmicSoftware/context-engine/main/README.md
- AI agent bootstrap: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgalmicSoftware/context-engine/main/docs/ai-agent-bootstrap.md
- Architecture: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgalmicSoftware/context-engine/main/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Whitepaper: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgalmicSoftware/context-engine/main/whitepaper/whitepaper.md

## Focus areas

- AI-assisted deliberation and sensemaking for large groups
- Public and private survey authoring and response collection
- SBT-gated access control and encrypted fields
- Passkey-oriented onboarding and account UX
- Cloudflare Worker support, Arweave storage, and EVM integrations
- Deterministic browser automation via a stable TestID API
